sources.title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni Reasoning BF16 model card
sources.evidence: Identifies NVIDIA and Nemotron family, April 28 release, downloadable BF16/FP8/NVFP4 weights, governing NVIDIA Open Model Agreement, Mamba2-Transformer hybrid MoE, four input modalities and text output, reasoning toggle and tool calling. The architecture subsection assigns nominal 31B/~3B to the language backbone; its headline count omits the complete multimodal checkpoint.

sources.title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni launch, April 28, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated April 28, 2026; announces availability that day through Hugging Face and inference platforms. Explicitly lists text, image, audio and video inputs, text output and open weights.

sources.title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Efficient and Open Multimodal Intelligence, v2
sources.evidence: Latest listed revision is May 11, 2026. Section 2 describes C-RADIOv4-H vision, Parakeet-TDT audio, projectors and Nemotron 3 Nano language decoder. Section 3.1.7 specifies 262,144-token context. This report does not state an exact complete multimodal parameter count or whole-model active count.

sources.title: Technical report version history
sources.evidence: Original paper submission April 27, 2026; latest listed version v2 May 11, 2026. Paper submission is not substituted for the explicitly documented April 28 model release.

sources.title: Exact BF16 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: 52-layer language pattern has 23 Mamba, 23 MoE and 6 attention blocks; 128 routed experts, top-6 routing, shared expert width 3712. Untied 131072-by-2688 embeddings and output matrix. Nested language maximum context is 262144; top-level max_sequence_length is 131072. Defines vision and audio encoder/projector dimensions.

sources.title: Exact multimodal model implementation
sources.evidence: Instantiates language, C-RADIO vision and Parakeet audio components, separate image/video patch projections, and vision/audio projectors. The released video projection has temporal patch size 2. Outputs generated text through the language model.

sources.title: Exact language decoder implementation
sources.evidence: Mamba2, attention and MoE modules establish learned tensor shapes, top-6 experts and shared experts. Router e_score_correction_bias is explicitly a registered buffer; Mamba A_log, D and dt_bias are learned Parameters.

sources.title: Complete 17-shard BF16 checkpoint index and bounded tensor headers
sources.evidence: All 7349 indexed tensor names were reconciled to headers fetched with bounded HTTP Range reads. Payload size 66031270520 bytes matches index metadata. All 7250 learned tensors are BF16; remaining 99 tensors are buffers. No full shard payloads were downloaded.

sources.title: C-RADIOv4-H ViT-H architecture definition
sources.evidence: vit_huge_patch16_224 defines 1280-wide, 32-layer, 16-head ViT. Combined with Omni config and checkpoint shapes, establishes all vision block dimensions.

sources.title: C-RADIO patch and position parameters
sources.evidence: Learned position embedding and patch projection; 2048 maximum resolution with patch size 16 gives 16384 position vectors. Omni adds its separate temporal video patch projection.

sources.title: C-RADIO class and register tokens
sources.evidence: Class/register token tensor is explicitly nn.Parameter. Three summary teachers and register multiple 10 produce ten 1280-wide learned tokens.

sources.title: C-RADIO normalization buffers
sources.evidence: Image normalization mean and standard deviation are explicitly registered buffers; six F32 elements are excluded from learned parameters.

sources.title: Exact audio encoder and projection wrapper
sources.evidence: Uses ParakeetEncoder configured with 24 layers, width 1024, intermediate width 4096, eight heads, 128 mel bins and subsampling factor eight, followed by a learned audio projector.

sources.title: Parakeet encoder implementation
sources.evidence: Defines subsampling convolutions, conformer blocks, five LayerNorms per block, BatchNorm, relative attention projections and learned bias_u/bias_v tensors. BatchNorm running mean, running variance and batch counters are buffers.

sources.title: NeMo acoustic feature buffers
sources.evidence: Mel filterbank fb and analysis window are registered buffers, confirming the corresponding retained checkpoint tensors are preprocessing state rather than learned parameters.

sources.title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni architecture guide
sources.evidence: The Hybrid MoE decoder table explicitly labels nominal 30B total and 3B active per forward pass, separately from vision/audio encoders and adaptors. Its license wording differs from the exact checkpoint card; the card links the governing NVIDIA Open Model Agreement, which takes precedence here.

sources.title: NVIDIA Open Model Agreement
sources.evidence: Exact governing terms linked by the released checkpoint card, named NVIDIA Open Model Agreement.

sources.title: Exact reasoning and tool-call chat template
sources.evidence: Implements thinking controls and serialized tool definitions, tool calls and tool responses for this checkpoint.

name.note: Matches the released reasoning variant; precision suffixes distinguish storage formats, not separate logical model releases.

family.note: Card explicitly places this model in the Nemotron family.

release_date.note: Exact day explicitly documented for Hugging Face, Build and NGC. April 27 is the paper submission date, not the documented model release.

open_weights.note: The official BF16 checkpoint is publicly accessible; its full index and every shard header were read.

license.note: Use the exact card-linked governing license. The architecture guide uses a different legacy Nemotron license name; do not copy that wording over the checkpoint terms.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete released BF16 checkpoint: 33,015,546,816 learned parameters in 7250 tensors, including language, vision, audio and both projectors. Independently reconstructed all 7349 stored tensor shapes from config/code and matched the complete index and bounded headers. Excludes 99 buffers totaling 85,422 elements. All learned tensors are BF16, with no quantization scale or packed-storage inflation. Advertised 30B/31B is a rounded language-backbone label, not this complete count.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal ~3B per token applies only to the language decoder; proposed active_parameters_scope is language_backbone. No precise active count for the complete multimodal pipeline is disclosed in the exact card, latest report v2 or architecture guide. Top-6 routing is independently confirmed. A structural subset retaining six experts per MoE block contains 3.580073408B when both full embedding/output matrices are counted, or 3.227751872B excluding the input embedding; these accounting conventions do not establish full multimodal per-token activity and are not substituted for the published nominal figure.

architecture.note: Mamba2-Transformer hybrid with 23 Mamba blocks, 6 attention blocks and 23 MoE blocks; each MoE has 128 routed experts, selects 6, and includes a shared expert. Dense vision/audio encoders feed the decoder.

context_window.note: Exact supported context from final SFT stage in latest report and llm_config.max_position_embeddings. Card 256k is shorthand. Top-level max_sequence_length=131072 conflicts with the trained capability; retain this deployment/configuration caveat instead of treating it as the full supported limit.

modalities.note: All four inputs are documented for this exact model. Audio/video understanding does not imply audio or video generation; output is text.

reasoning.note: Reasoning is enabled by default and can be disabled through enable_thinking; the report describes reasoning training and budget control.

tool_call.note: Card explicitly supports tool calling and documents serving parsers; the exact chat template supports tool definitions, calls and responses.

description.value: Mamba2-Transformer MoE reasoning model with C-RADIO vision and Parakeet audio encoders; accepts text, images, video and audio and generates text.
description.note: Describes supported architecture and input/output directions without benchmark or efficiency claims.

patch.description: Mamba2-Transformer MoE reasoning model with C-RADIO vision and Parakeet audio encoders; accepts text, images, video and audio and generates text.
patch.notes: Complete BF16 checkpoint: 33.015546816B learned parameters, including vision/audio encoders and projectors. The advertised ~3B active figure is nominal and language-backbone-only; full multimodal activity varies by input and phase. Decoder uses 23 Mamba, 6 attention and 23 MoE blocks with 6 of 128 routed experts plus a shared expert. The report and nested language config support 262144 tokens; top-level max_sequence_length is 131072, so deployment settings may impose a lower limit.

checkpoint_audit.method: For each shard, fetch exactly bytes 0-7 to decode the little-endian uint64 header length, then bytes 8 through header_length+7. Require HTTP 206 and exact response lengths; never read tensor payloads. Reconcile names against complete index, contiguous offsets, dtype element sizes and index total_size. Reconstruct all names and shapes independently from configuration and model implementations.
checkpoint_audit.component_notes: Vision count includes 1,966,080 separate video patch-projection parameters. Language count includes untied input and output embeddings. Audio count excludes preprocessing and BatchNorm buffers; learned relative-attention bias_u/bias_v are retained. Frozen-at-later-training-stage learned weights are still counted.

summary: Correct total from nominal 30B to complete 33.015546816B learned parameters; add NVIDIA Open Model Agreement; correct 256000 context to 262144. Preserve nominal ~3B active only with language_backbone scope and component breakdown. Confirm April 28 release, hybrid MoE, four input modalities, text-only output, reasoning and tool calling. Whole multimodal active parameters are not independently disclosed; no fabricated complete active count.
